introHtml: Hit bottle openers combine durable metal construction with a compact design that fits easily on a keychain or behind the bar. Bulk buyers appreciate the variety of shapes, from key rings to pizza wheel styles, all ready for custom imprint with your logo. These openers hold up to daily use and make practical promotional items for restaurants, breweries, or trade shows.
